title: Insured Portal Bookings on an Appointment Series
content:
Patient portal terms — booking standing appointments online on an Appointment Series paid for by insurance.

## 1. What an insured portal booking is

An insured portal booking is the batch of standing appointments a patient books for themselves through the patient portal on an appointment series funded by an Insured Plan of Care. The booking adds the stated number of consecutive standing appointments, starting on the date chosen, to the appointments still booked on the series, and records the booking as made through the portal. What these terms govern is the number of appointments such a booking opens.

## 2. When the number is settled

The number of appointments an insured portal booking opens is fixed only after every late cancellation received before its appointment day and recorded on the series within its fee assessment period shows a late-cancellation fee entry.

An insured portal booking is not opened until every no-show recorded on the series within its fee assessment period, other than one on the series' first appointment, shows a no-show fee entry.

## 3. The portal action: `book_insured_portal_visits_a191f0e3`

**Capability.** The action books, in the patient portal, a batch of standing appointments on the patient's own appointment series that the patient's insurance plan of care pays for. One run books the stated number of consecutive standing appointments starting on the chosen date, adds them to the appointments still booked on the series and records the booking as made through the portal; the patient sees the new appointments on their schedule.

**Who runs it.** It is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks `book_insured_portal_visits_a191f0e3` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the patient, in the patient portal — runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `series_id` | the reference number of the patient's appointment series, as read out to the patient by the patient services representative from the appointment series lookup | text identifier |
| `appointment_date` | the date of the earliest appointment of the new batch, falling on one of the series' standing weekdays | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, clinic local time |
| `visits` | how many standing appointments to book in this batch, as told to the patient by the representative | a non-negative integer (visits) |

**Return.** On success: `booking_reference` (the reference number of the new booking; its presence means the appointments were booked), `series_id` (the series the appointments were added to), `first_appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the earliest appointment booked), `visits_booked` (the number of appointments booked), `booking_channel` (always `patient_portal`) and `booked_visits_remaining` (the appointments now booked and not yet attended on the series). No other return or error is defined.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A run with `visits` of 3 on a series holding 2 booked appointments returns `visits_booked` 3, `booking_channel` `patient_portal` and `booked_visits_remaining` 5.
